safety: Always run with enclosure closed and ventilation/fume extraction on.

Never laser PVC, vinyl, or other chlorinated plastics (release chlorine/HCl gas, corrode the machine), polycarbonate/Lexan, ABS, PTFE/Teflon, fiberglass, coated carbon fiber, or anything of unknown composition.
Stay with the machine during cuts; keep a fire extinguisher nearby.
Wear laser-rated eye protection for the specific wavelength when the shield is open.
